# Step: Identify all products matching 'HP Pavilion 15 Laptop' exactly, across all pages
import re
api_products=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res = apis.amazon.search_products(query='HP Pavilion 15 Laptop', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not isinstance(res, list):
        print('Non-list response', type(res))
        break
    if not res:
        break
    api_products.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
print('total_found_products', len(api_products))
# filter exact name match
matches=[p for p in api_products if str(p.get('name','')).strip().lower()=='hp pavilion 15 laptop']
print('exact_name_matches', len(matches))
print([(p['product_id'], p.get('seller_id'), p.get('product_type'), p.get('price'), p.get('num_product_reviews'), p.get('num_product_questions')) for p in matches[:10]])
# If multiple, list all
print('all_match_product_ids', [p['product_id'] for p in matches])

product_id=1570
# Fetch all verified reviews (is_verified=True) with pagination
page_index=0
page_limit=20
reviews=[]
while True:
    res = apis.amazon.show_product_reviews(product_id=product_id, is_verified=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # print page sizes
    print('page', page_index, 'returned', len(res) if isinstance(res,list) else res)
    if not isinstance(res, list) or len(res)==0:
        break
    reviews.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
print('total_verified_reviews', len(reviews))
# extract hour mentions from review text
import re
pattern=re.compile(r'(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:hours?|hrs?|hr)\b', re.IGNORECASE)
hours=[]
examples=[]
for r in reviews:
    txt=(r.get('text') or '')
    for m in pattern.finditer(txt):
        val=float(m.group(1))
        hours.append(val)
        if len(examples)<10:
            examples.append((val, txt[max(0,m.start()-30):m.start()+30]))
print('hour_mentions_count', len(hours))
print('hour_values_sample', hours[:20])
print('examples', examples)
